findings.claim: Error/breadcrumb interleave compares nodestore error timestamps (float seconds) against rrweb event timestamps (milliseconds), so error_ts < event_ts is always true and every error is emitted before the first breadcrumb instead of in chronological order.
findings.evidence: rrweb fixtures use ms (tests/sentry/replays/unit/test_event_parser.py:329 'timestamp': 1674291701348); nodestore event 'timestamp' is seconds. Executed repro (superpowers seat, scratch repro_replay_ts.py) with breadcrumbs at 1700000000000/1700000005000 ms and error at 1700000002.0 s fails the chronological-order assertion. New tests mask it by writing rrweb timestamps in seconds (tests/sentry/replays/test_project_replay_summarize_breadcrumbs.py:188).
findings.reason: Two independent correctness seats, one with an executed failing repro against HEAD source.

findings.claim: fetch_error_details zips error_ids with events.values() from nodestore.get_multi, which dedupes ids, returns uncached items first then cached ones, and omits missing ids; error ids get paired with the wrong event's title/message/timestamp.
findings.evidence: src/sentry/nodestore/base.py get_multi: dedupe and items.update(cache_items) after fetched items (~:184-205). Proposed test: warm cache for A only, call fetch_error_details(project.id,[A,B]); A's entry receives B's data. Fix: events.get(node_id) per id.
findings.reason: Ordering assumption contradicted by cited nodestore source; the wrong title/message/timestamp feeds the Seer prompt even if id itself is unused. OCR rated Important, superpowers Minor; kept Important.

findings.claim: Serializer makes destination and attempts required, but browsers POST only age/type/url/user_agent/body (W3C Reporting 'serialize reports'); real browser payloads get 422 and one bad report rejects the whole batch.
findings.evidence: Reasoned from the W3C spec, not a captured payload. Both test fixtures (DEPRECATION_REPORT, INTERVENTION_REPORT) invent destination/attempts. Proposed failing test: POST [{age:0,type:'deprecation',url:'https://x.com/',user_agent:'UA',body:{}}] with option enabled expects 200, gets 422. Superpowers notes the old dataclass had the same assumption (not a regression).
findings.reason: Two correctness seats agree; consistent with the W3C serialization algorithm. Unverified against a live browser payload; settle with a captured Chrome Reporting API request.

findings.claim: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES (is_segment, project_id, received) is applied only after the early 'if (!searchQuery.trim()) return sorted;', so in the default no-search view the attributes are still shown; they are hidden only while searching.
findings.evidence: Reasoned from code order at attributes.tsx:61-69. Proposed failing test: render Attributes with an attribute named project_id and empty search; expect it absent, it is present.
findings.reason: Two correctness seats; the commit intent ('Hiding some attrs') is defeated in the common path.

findings.claim: New 'use-table-widget-visualization' branch renders TableWidgetVisualization with columns=[] and empty data, ignoring tableResults/loading; the flag is not registered in src/sentry/features/temporary.py, so the branch and the new component have no live caller.
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'use-table-widget-visualization' src/ returns nothing; other flags in the patch are in temporary.py (lines 441, 278). CLAUDE.md: 'Feature Flags: Always add for new features'.
findings.reason: Work-in-progress behind an unregistered flag (may be registered in getsentry, not checked); no user impact until enabled. Normalized from Important (ponytail/standards) to Minor because it is unreachable. ponytail: register flag and feed tableResults before enabling.

findings.claim: age/timestamp mutual-exclusion validators use truthiness (initial_data.get), so age:0 with timestamp passes, and a report with neither field passes despite the docstrings; validate_timestamp/validate_age are duplicate code replaceable by one validate().
findings.evidence: browser_reporting_collector.py:50-60; both fields required=False. Reasoned.
findings.reason: All four seats raised it; trivial to make red with a payload containing age:0 and timestamp.
